result.reason: The revision provides a customer convenience-termination right, eliminates early-termination fees, requires a pro-rata refund of prepaid charges, and grants IBM no convenience-termination right. Although the month-end restriction means termination is not always effective exactly 30 days after notice, the resulting delay is generally no worse than the 60–90-day fallback. The edits are targeted and professionally drafted, while preserving the scope and prerequisite-attachment carveout.
